records.title_en: Hungary’s Industrial Output Rises 4.7% in July
records.summary_en:
The Budapest Business Journal reports Hungarian statistical office figures showing July industrial output up 4.7% year on year and 1.7% month on month after seasonal and working-day adjustment. Output in January–July rose 2.7% year on year.

Monthly annual growth, adjusted monthly growth and cumulative growth are different measures. July's increase is not a full-year growth rate.

records.title_en: Hungary Annual Inflation Reaches 1.3% in August

Headline inflation and its component changes are distinct measures. These annual changes should not be read as monthly changes.
